description:
Adventure Game Studio (AGS) provides the tools to make your own adventure, for free!


This is a 3.6.2 Patch 12.
Editor:
- Editor's setting "Popup message on compile" will be applied when saving rooms too.
- Fixed Project Tree and View Selection tree controls flickering when being hovered over by a mouse cursor.
- Fixed Editor crashing on launch when there's a game with a very long name present in "Recent Games" list.
- Fixed autocomplete crashing if there's an unclosed string literal in script.
- Fixed autocomplete registering non-existing variables if a string literal contained a variable declaration syntax as a part of a string.
- Fixed script editor hanging forever when there's a "]" character typed right at the beginning of a new line.
Compiler:
- Fixed forward struct declarations. They could cause obscure mistakes sometimes.
- Fixed line numbering in script files with UNIX line endings (LF).
Engine:
- Do not start blocking animation or movement for a disabled Character or Object.
  This could lead to infinite game freeze, as neither animation or movement are updated if the object is disabled, and since the action is blocking, it will wait in a loop forever.
- Fixed Buttons switching to their "MouseOver" graphic when mouse cursor hovers them, even though their parent GUI is overlayed by another, clickable GUI.
- Fixed inconsistent Slider handle position, introduced by a incorrect slider fix in the previous patches. The slider looks should now be synced with 3.6.0 (and higher versions).
- Fixed a Room applying special view for the player character did not adjust the loop to be within a valid range.
- Fixed loop range limit used when selecting a suitable loop after changing to another normal view or unlocking a temporary view. Previously, it seems, it used full range of loops in the current normal view, now it should use only first 4 or 8 standard standing loops (depending on "use diagonal loops" setting).
- Fixed potential crash which could occur if script is trying to access certain Room Object's properties via 'object[]' array in a Room that has no objects or does not have this specific object.
- Fixed that after restoring a save with less number of objects (of any type), accessing these objects in script would lead to a script error.
- Fixed that the new room is not drawn immediately with Crossfade and Dissolve transition, but only after "Before fade in" event callback completes.
- Fixed loading of 1-, 4- and 8-bit BMP files which width is not multiple of 4.
- Fixed Software renderer not clearing surface after the room viewport is moved around screen.
- Fixed Software renderer displaying room viewport incorrectly if it's moved partially offscreen.
- Fixed Debug(0) ("give all inventory") cheat reducing larger inventory item quantity to 1.
- Fixed formatting mistakes in some game log messages.
Compatibility:
- Global messages and Room messages now properly support unicode texts (in case of translations).
- Fixed slider handle visual position in pre-3.6.0 games.
- Fixed legacy pathfinder's regression, which can lead to chararacter not being to arrive at certain area (happens when running old games).
